title: Bossypants
author: Tina Fey
summary: Tina Fey writes about her awkward adolescence, years in improv and television, and life as a working mother. She covers Saturday Night Live and 30 Rock with self-deprecating humour.
readIf: you want a quick, jokey memoir about comedy and being a woman at work.
skipIf: you want deep revelations or a detailed behind-the-scenes history.
